steps.title: Run the Linux ARM64 package
steps.instruction: Extract the release ZIP, then unpack DK64Recompiled.tar.gz. Start DK64Recompiled from the extracted folder. The current ARM64 build needs glibc 2.35 or newer, SDL2, GTK 3, libatomic, libcurl and a Vulkan-capable driver.

steps.title: Install the Linux x64 Flatpak
steps.instruction: Extract the Flatpak x64 ZIP to get io.github.dk64recompiled.dk64recompiled.flatpak. Install the file with Flatpak, then start io.github.dk64recompiled.dk64recompiled from the app menu or with flatpak run io.github.dk64recompiled.dk64recompiled.

steps.title: Select your original
steps.instruction: In the upstream game picker choose your own USA 1.0 Donkey Kong 64 cartridge dump. The game validates the matching original before play.

warnings: Portcove manages the official Windows, Linux x64 and Apple Silicon Mac packages. The Linux ARM64 and Flatpak packages use upstream or player-managed setup, replacement and data backups.
Portcove has no native Mac execution, macOS first-launch (Gatekeeper) result or populated-save result for this package.

references.title: Keep an upstream-managed profile
references.instruction: If you already use an upstream-managed copy, preserve ~/.config/DK64Recompiled on Linux, the DK64Recompiled profile under ~/Library/Application Support on Mac, or your actual custom profile. For Flatpak also keep ~/.var/app/io.github.dk64recompiled.dk64recompiled. Back up the original, saves, mods and settings before replacing it. Portcove-managed installs keep their data in the Portcove profile and do not adopt these folders.
